purpose: Pending native-link throw escapes to the caller without entering the child catch. A raw reference cache and copied old row distinguish cache reads, COW ownership and explicit close history after the same supplied Exception is caught.

<?php
class ReviewPendingOld21 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewPendingLive21 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewPendingLeaf21() { global $cache; try { echo "C|"; yield 7 => $cache; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CATCH|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewPendingMiddle21() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewPendingOuter21() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$cache = [new ReviewPendingOld21()]; $exception = new Exception("pending21");
$child = reviewPendingLeaf21(); $middle = reviewPendingMiddle21(); $outer = reviewPendingOuter21();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind();
$row = $middle->current(); $cache = [new ReviewPendingLive21()]; echo "W|";
try { $middle->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewPendingLive21 ? 1 : 0, "|", $middle->key(), "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$row[0] = null; unset($row); echo "ROW|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
unset($cache, $caught, $exception); echo "E";
